note: Additional planner evidence from the observing round (map-augment-1768): (1) direct artifact evidence — ~/.cache/pre-commit/ patch files written at 00:17 and 00:18 during the round's commits, incl. a 110 KB stash of the unstaged artifact diff, timestamps bracketing the observed reversion windows; (2) the DIAGNOSTIC TELL separating 'stash race' from 'live writer', for both the fix and any future reviewer: the race CONVERGES the tree back to HEAD within seconds and leaves ~/.cache/pre-commit/patch<ts>-<pid> files bracketing the window, whereas a live writer leaves a monotonically GROWING set of new files plus a live pid; (3) a reviewer polling git status on a parked task saw cells flip deleted->modified->clean purely from this mechanism — reviewer-side guidance should carry the tell.

Third evidence item from the observing round (map-augment-1768): under the shared-root race, a FAILED commit (rc=1, pre-commit 'modified files') can coincide with a SUCCEEDING push whose pushed SHA is ANOTHER session's commit — so 'push succeeded' does NOT imply 'my commit landed'. The round's mitigation: verify landing by reading git blobs at the specific SHA (git cat-file / show against origin), never by the push line. The fix's guidance half should carry this verification recipe alongside the off-root generation pattern.
